messages:
amanda_pm: quick sync  ACMEHealth wants more visibility before pilot GA. They asked for three things: better dashboard templates for common flows, per-route cost attribution, and lightweight tracing hooks on error paths. We need to prioritize for the upcoming sprint.

lucy_csm: ACMEHealth is on a timebox for audit. They said dashboards + cost are 'must have', tracing is a hard ask but theyd accept reduced scope if it helps timeline.

raj_engineer: technical note: dashboards + cost attribution are mostly data + UI work. Tracing hooks hit runtime and agent layers; risk of perf regressions if we naively add tags/sampling.

ellie_sre: +1. If we do tracing we should limit enrichment and put it behind a dynamic flag. Also define the perf gate up front.

michael_prodops: proposed acceptance criteria: 1) three dashboard templates (requests, latency, cost), 2) route-level cost breakdown with org attribution, 3) tracing hooks feature-flagged and off by default, can be enabled in canary. Perf gate: no >5% CPU increase or >10ms p50 latency delta.

jordan_data: for cost attribution I'll need joins on request_id -> model_variant -> GPU_time. Draft SQL Ill share: `SELECT org_id, route, SUM(gpu_ms * tokens) as cost_est FROM request_metrics GROUP BY org_id, route`

raj_engineer: rough dev estimates: dashboards 4d frontend + 2d backend, cost attribution 3d data + 2d api, tracing hooks (error-only) 5d infra + 1d agent QA = ~17 dev-days total.

amanda_pm: recommended plan: ship dashboards + cost in first cut this sprint; tracing as error-only beta behind flag. If ACME insists on full traces we can negotiate an expedited follow-up but not at the cost of stability.

lucy_csm: ACME says error-only is acceptable as interim. They'll run audit team on that with a caveat: they want links from traces to dashboard traces for root-cause.

ellie_sre: we can add a lightweight correlation tag `route` + `request_id` to error spans and async-enrich before persisting. Config sample:
```
agent.trace.capture_errors: true
agent.trace.async_enrich: true
trace.span_tags: ["request_id","route"]
```

raj_engineer: that reduces runtime pressure. Update estimate: tracing hooks now 3d infra + 1d QA.

michael_prodops: rollout safety: canary at 10% for 2 hours with auto-disable if latency or error deltas exceed thresholds. We should codify rollback triggers in runbook.

amanda_pm: action items: Raj opens RFC for the error-only tracing hook and perf plan; Jordan posts SQL prototype; Michael adds rollout/rollback criteria to launch checklist; Lucy confirms ACME acceptance; Ellie schedules perf canary. Owners pls tag tickets with `#planning`. Reconvene after RFC + SQL prototype.

raj_engineer: I'll open the RFC and include canary steps and perf scripts.

jordan_data: SQL prototype up by EOD.

lucy_csm: I'll get ACME to sign off on the interim error-only plan today.

deploybot: deploy status: none.

amanda_pm: thanks team. We'll close this thread and pick up in planning tomorrow. Ping if blockers show up.
